description: Ministry of Education - Order made Under Section 27(1) Eastern University, Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette content involves the amendment of a university schedule through a statutory order made under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It represents a regulatory modification to the legal framework governing higher education institutions, specifically adding a new department to the Eastern University's Faculty of Arts and Culture. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory changes rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
